_comment: Multi-account fleet manifest. Each account runs as its own OS subprocess
with an isolated FLEET_STATE_DIR (live/fleet/<name>). Run with:
IB NOTE: each IB account needs a UNIQUE (host, port, client_id) triple.
One IB Gateway typically serves one funded account; multiple IB accounts
generally require separate Gateways on distinct ports.
Secrets may be left out here and supplied via ambient env / .env instead
(TopStep validation, however, requires explicit user+api_key per account).
